en: Leviticus 6

p.src: 1  The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
u.src: 1  The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

p.src: 2  “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against the LORD, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

ja: に背き、預かり物、取引、強奪に関して
き、あるいは隣人をしいたげ、
en: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against the LORD, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,
u.src: 2  “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against the LORD, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

p.src: 3  or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—

ja: つけたのにそれについて嘘をつき、
って罪となるこれらのことのいずれかを行ったなら、
en: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—
u.src: 3  or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—

p.src: 4  then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

ja: けられたもの、または彼が
en: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,
u.src: 4  then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

p.src: 5  or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.

ja: ったものすべてについて、その全
en: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.

p.src: 6  He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

を、償いのささげ物として持って
en: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.
u.src: 6  He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

p.src: 7  The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

ja: となったどんなことについても
en: The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

p.src: 9  “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

ja: を絶やしてはならない。

p.src: 10  The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

en: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
u.src: 10  The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

p.src: 11  He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

en: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

ja: けていなければならず、
en: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

en: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

に彼らの分となる。それらに
